question: How much of the fixed-16 oWALNUTS / CmdStan ESS-per-gradient headline is seed noise and competitor failure on one model? WP64: pooled six-seed geomean 1.206 on Linux vs 0.761 on Windows, driven by CmdStan's second-mode chains on hmm_drive_0 (4/6 Linux seeds); without hmm_drive_0 0.862 vs 0.749.

commit.note: WP62's commit, also used by WP64's extension cells; its default sampler equals that of v7's f097391c (WP62). The harness crate is byte-identical to posteriordb_bench_v7's and is built from a clean sparse worktree of this commit; the driver refuses oWALNUTS cells otherwise.

design.models: WP62's fixed 16 (posteriordb_bench_v7_seed_extension/protocol.json 'models'), read at run time
design.arms: owalnuts (Sampler::new() defaults, run shape only) and CmdStan 2.39.0 via cmdstanpy 1.3.0 at defaults; no nutpie
design.run_shape: 4 chains x 1,000 warmup / 1,000 retained, 4 threads; gates, gate parameters, cell timeout (2,700 s) and cell code as WP62 / v7
design.run_order: models in WP62 order; arms owalnuts then cmdstan; seeds ascending; strictly sequential; no reruns
design.binaries: the 16 BridgeStan libraries and CmdStan executables copied from WP64's Linux build (posteriordb_bench_v7_linux_v1/models, compiled on this box from posteriordb 28f8d3d), as WP62 copied v7's

seeds.verified_unused: git grep -wE '7207(0[1-9]|1[0-2])' over every tracked file at main 5d0cf176 and the sibling worktrees' protocols found none

platform.machine: AWS EC2 c7a.4xlarge (AMD EPYC 9R14), Ubuntu 24.04, lane 1 (taskset -c 0-3, RAYON_NUM_THREADS=4, OMP_NUM_THREADS=1), files under ~/lanes/posteriordb_ratio_robustness_v1/
platform.wall_label_note: Linux, core-pinned to 4 dedicated cores (taskset -c 0-3) on a shared box with other pinned lanes active (shared L3 and memory bandwidth): walls are 'pinned, co-tenanted'. Pass counts and ESS per gradient are unaffected by co-tenancy.
platform.software: lane venv on Python 3.12.3: cmdstanpy 1.3.0, bridgestan 2.9.0, arviz 0.23.4, numpy 2.4.6, scipy 1.17.1, xarray 2026.9.0, posteriordb 0.2.0, pandas 3.1.0 (WP64's set); Rust 1.88.0; CmdStan 2.39.0 and posteriordb 28f8d3d from ~/infra

analysis.pool: 18 Linux seeds: WP64's 560561-560563 (v7 harness at f097391c) and 620601-620603 (c5c60122), read unchanged from STUDIES/posteriordb_bench_v7_linux_v1/artifacts/{v7,ext}/cells, plus the 12 new seeds. Seeds are treated as exchangeable (identical default sampler).
analysis.per_cell_quantity: min bulk ESS over the gate parameters / gradients_total (v7's min_bulk_ess_per_gradient), status-ok cells only
analysis.min_ok_note: WP62's 5-of-6 rule generalised: a model enters (a), (c), (d) if both arms (for (c): both arms on the same seed) have at least ceil(5n/6) ok cells among the n seeds (15 of 18)

a.name: v7 pooled geomean
a.definition: per model and arm, median over ok cells of ESS/gradient; model ratio = oWALNUTS median / CmdStan median; geomean over included models (WP62's pooled statistic)

b.name: joint-pass
b.definition: as (a) but each model uses only seeds where both arms' cells pass all gates; model enters with at least min_joint_passing_seeds such seeds

c.name: median of paired ratios
c.definition: per model, the per-seed ratio oWALNUTS / CmdStan on seeds where both cells are ok, then the median across seeds; geomean over models

d.name: (a) without hmm_drive_0
d.definition: (a) with bball_drive_event_0-hmm_drive_0 removed from the model set

bootstrap.unit: seed (all 16 models and both arms of a seed move together)
bootstrap.note: resampled seeds may repeat; inclusion counts use the resampled multiset

analysis.single_model_sensitivity: leave-one-model-out: max over included models of |ln(stat) - ln(stat without that model)|, with the model named

headline_rule.rule: The v8 headline is the eligible statistic with the smaller leave-one-model-out influence on the 18-seed Linux pool; ties go to (c). (b) is ineligible because it drops every cell where oWALNUTS fails a gate, so it does not count oWALNUTS's own failures. (d) is ineligible because it removes a model named after seeing results; it is the diagnostic for (a), not a rule that generalises to the next stuck competitor.
headline_rule.why_c: (c) pairs the arms on the same seed and takes the median across 18 seeds, so a competitor stuck chain on a minority of a model's seeds changes only those seeds' ratios and the median absorbs them; oWALNUTS's own failures still count, because every ok cell enters, a low oWALNUTS ESS lowers that seed's ratio, and persistently failing models (accel_gp, centered Eight Schools, one_comp) stay in at their measured ratios. Stated limitation: if a competitor fails on half or more of a model's seeds, no median absorbs it; the leave-one-model-out influence makes that visible.

stuck_chain.definition: a chain is stuck (displaced) if, for some gate parameter, |chain mean - posteriordb reference mean| / reference sd > 5; counted per cell from the retained draws (.npz) for every model and both arms on the 18 Linux seeds; reported per seed for hmm_drive_0
stuck_chain.calibration: chosen on WP64's six already-published hmm_drive_0 cells, where stuck CmdStan chains sit at 68-280 reference sd and every other chain at <= 0.1

Q1.text: (b) on the 18-seed Linux pool lies in [0.80, 0.95]

Q2.text: (c) on the 18-seed Linux pool lies in [0.80, 0.95]

Q3.text: (a) stays above 1.0 only because of hmm_drive_0: (a) > 1.0 and (d) <= 1.0

reported: the four statistics with bootstrap intervals and leave-one-model-out influence on the 12 new seeds alone, on WP64's six Linux seeds, and on the six Windows seeds (WP56 + WP62 cells; no draws, so no stuck-chain counts); per-model ratios; gates per arm /192 new and /288 pooled; stuck-chain counts per seed for hmm_drive_0 (both arms) and per model for all 16; walls labelled pinned, co-tenanted
rules: Freeze PREREGISTRATION.md and protocol.json in a commit before the first cell. Sequential cells; failures and timeouts are results; no reruns, no tuning after results. A driver crash may be relaunched; only an interrupted cell without a completed artifact may be rerun from scratch with the same seed, recorded in AMENDMENTS.md. Raw draws and CmdStan output are checksummed and not committed.
